The role: CRM Lifecycle Marketing Specialist

As our first CRM Lifecycle Marketing Specialist, you will own the relationship with every company that signs up to Spiko, from the moment they create an account to the day they refer a peer. Thousands of businesses onboard on their own each month. Your job is to turn those sign-ups into active, growing, loyal clients, at scale, through email, in-app and push.

You will own Customer.io end to end and build the programs that get self-onboarded prospects to their first deposit, get existing clients to deposit more, keep them from leaving, and turn the happiest ones into referrers and reviewers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Customer.io: Be the owner of our lifecycle marketing platform. Refine the data model (events, attributes, segments) with the data and product teams, build and maintain campaigns and journeys, manage templates and deliverability, and keep the tool clean and well-documented as we scale.

  • Activate self-onboarded prospects at scale: Design and run the onboarding journeys that take a company from account creation through KYC to first deposit. Identify where prospects drop, and build the sequences, nudges and content that get them across the line.

  • Grow deposits from existing clients: Build campaigns that increase the share of cash our clients put to work with Spiko: milestone nudges, product and feature adoption, cross-currency and multi-product campaigns, reactivation of dormant accounts.

  • Drive referrals and reviews: Own the promotion of our referral program and the mechanics that get satisfied clients to leave reviews. Find the right moments, the right incentives and the right message to make advocacy a habit.

  • Retain and win back: Define at-risk signals with the data team, build churn-prevention and win-back flows, and measure their impact on retained AuM.

  • Segment smartly: Own the segmentation strategy. Work with the data team to define audiences by company profile, cash position, behavior and lifecycle stage, so every message reaches the right client at the right time.

  • A/B test everything: Run a structured experimentation roadmap: test copy, timing, channel, offers and incentives. Document learnings and ship the winners.

  • Report on impact: Own the lifecycle dashboard: activation rate, time to first deposit, deposit conversion, referral rate, review volume, unsubscribe and deliverability metrics. Share results and next steps with the growth, sales and product teams.

  • Lifecycle / CRM marketing experience: You have at least 3 years running lifecycle, CRM or retention marketing in a B2B SaaS or fintech company, with a track record of measurably improving activation, expansion or retention.

  • Hands-on with a lifecycle platform: You have built and run campaigns yourself in Customer.io, Braze, Klaviyo or a similar tool: segments, event-triggered journeys, Liquid or equivalent templating, deliverability.

  • Data fluency: You are comfortable defining events and attributes with a data team and reading a dashboard. You make decisions from numbers, not hunches.

  • Sharp copywriting: You can write the kind of email a busy CFO or founder will actually open, read and act on. English fluency is mandatory.

  • Rigor and structure: You handle many campaigns, segments and tests in parallel without losing track, and you document what you build.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You are creative, proactive, and highly ambitious, driven to play a key role in building a global leader in financial services, fully embracing the dedication and challenges this entails.

  • Autonomy: You are highly autonomous in managing the responsibilities of this role, reporting to the Head of Growth.

  • A real interest in finance: You care about financial services and you're excited about what Spiko is building.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a regulated environment (fintech, banking, asset management) and comfort working with compliance on customer communications.

  • Experience launching or scaling a referral program or a review-generation program.

  • Experience with in-app messaging and push, or with tools like Make / n8n to automate lifecycle workflows.

Every Embedded partnership is a complex B2B negotiation with another fintech, spanning commercial terms, regulatory structuring across jurisdictions, and product customisation. We need someone to own the legal and regulatory work behind it.

Legal lead on Spiko Embedded

Regulatory Compliance

  • In partnership with the Compliance team, you will handle various aspects of the regulatory compliance of our activities.
